semantics: Torus vertical thickness on the craniometric chord scale: 0 = recent modern human (6.5 mm midorbit thickness); +65 = Krapina [D]; gorilla +100 [E]. Kept separate from BrowProjection because the fossil table shows them moving semi-independently (Upper Paleolithic thickness sits at the recent level while its projection is +28). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
